title: Composition of maps
statement: Let $f$ map Boolean lists to Boolean lists, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For natural numbers $a_1,k_1,a_2,k_2$, first take from $z$ the slice specified by $a_1,k_1$ and apply $f$ to it; pair the result with the second component obtained from the complementary slice of $z$, encode that pair, and take the slice specified by $a_2,k_2$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers a₁, k₁, a₂, k₂
A function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists
caveat: The supplied statement omits definitions of the slicing, pair encoding, and second-component operations, so their precise interval conventions cannot be stated.
